integration_adaptations: Owned shared/thread/socket lifetimes replace private CRT containers and detached raw-pointer lifetime assumptions.
Source provider/main-extra overlap and readiness dependency order are retained; management wait additionally waits for complete initialization.
A per-session cipher lock and shared router-state lock serialize only mutable C++ state; source native scheduling/timing equivalence is not asserted.

Unexpected request exceptions close the managed session and remain reported failures. Source explicit ExitProcess policies are retained. This is an owned exception-containment boundary, not original native EH equivalence.
Source per-hook create/enable remains; owner detects installation failure and rolls back before ready instead of reporting a partially initialized application as ready.
All eleven slots are available; process/folder hooks follow source conditional settings.
Public C API implemented in the subsequent YF-PUBLIC-ABI task; earlier 548-byte ABI requirement withdrawn for lack of supplied authoritative layout.
Startup abort releases private source wait gates after admission closes; it remains a failed startup and cannot make the DLL ready API return success.
Synchronous greeting remains on the IO owner, with cancelable nonblocking retries so stop can drain a peer that never reads; actual8MiB blocked-greeting regression passes.
